segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Karen, thanks for making the time. I wanted to walk through the final seat count and the go-live timing, then we can get the order form updated today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that works. We landed at 42 seats for phase one, all in customer operations. There may be another 8 later, but I don't want those on this first invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 42 seats only for the initial term. The pricing sheet has that at $68 per seat per month with the annual prepay discount, so the subscription total is $34,272 for the year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And implementation was still $6,500, right? Finance asked me to confirm because the first draft showed $7,000.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, $6,500. I already updated that in the CRM notes and I'll make sure deal desk uses the revised amount on the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. On timing, we're targeting a September 16 go-live. Is that still realistic if we sign by Friday?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If we have signature by August 9, we can start kickoff the week of August 19. That gives us four weeks for configuration, data import, admin training, and UAT.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Legal had one small note on auto-renewal. They want 60 days' notice instead of 30 for non-renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's fine. We can set the renewal notice period to 60 days. No change to the 12-month initial term or payment terms, still net 30 on invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Net 30 is okay. Please send the revised order form to me and copy Daniel in procurement. He'll route it for signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it this afternoon with 42 seats, $34,272 subscription, $6,500 implementation, September 16 target go-live, and 60-day renewal notice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks. If it comes in before 3 p.m. Eastern, I can get it into our approval queue today.
